common_findings: N2,J1 modestly prefer E055; N1,N3,J2 tie, all medium confidence. E055 more directly establishes a necessary information-access condition indexed to the actual error and review task. E098 gives a credible positive account of standing supported guidance without attributing the helper's monitoring to the performer. No fatal error or established historical novelty in either.

remaining_issues.E055: Justification of review scope is assumed, not derived. Failure class, conditional reliability, timing and unequal access require calibration. Much is refinement of acknowledged tracking/contestability antecedents; no universal human-supervision duty.
remaining_issues.E098: The positive attribution of a present supported capacity may leave substantive disagreement with an opportunity/regained-guidance account unclear. Equal workshops are stipulated for the specified publicly updated task, not every private change of purpose. Performing monitoring, directing it and joint organizational control need further differentiation.

coordinator_text_check: The private-target-change objection is expressly limited by the manuscript's specified work order and replacement-information discussion; do not call it a contradiction. E055 separates individual appeal from practice-level audit and does not identify independence with different suppliers.
decision: Two preferences and three ties provide a slight E055 advantage with substantial neutral/profile dissent. No automatic elimination or field-based bonus.
